name: Innkeeper Firebrew
summary: At the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge’s Commons, Innkeeper Firebrew gives travelers food and rest. His hearty dwarven fare welcomes mountaineers and visiting dignitaries beneath the mountain.

sections.title: Keeper of the Stonefire
sections.body:
Innkeeper Firebrew welcomes travelers at the Stonefire Tavern in the Commons. The tavern stands in the Commons’ central ring, and many arriving through the Great Gates find it first. Behind a counter of ale, stout, and roasted meat, Firebrew serves those bound for Dun Morogh’s snowy passes or deeper into the mountain kingdom.

Miners, riflemen, and emissaries gather there to leave the drafty tunnels behind and trade tales around the hearth. The Stonefire remains a lively crossroads in the heart of Ironforge.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Firebrew?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Firebrew can be found inside the Stonefire Tavern, along the southern edge of Ironforge’s Commons.

faq.q: What kind of goods does Firebrew sell?
faq.answer: Firebrew sells standard innkeeper provisions, including robust dwarven rations. Travelers can buy Dwarven Stout and Mead, imported wines, meats, and hearty meals for long journeys.

faq.q: Is Firebrew part of any dwarven brewing family?
faq.answer: Firebrew bears the surname Firebrew, but his family relationships are not confirmed.

faq.q: What services does he provide to travelers?
faq.answer: Firebrew lets Alliance travelers bind their hearthstones to the Stonefire Tavern. He also provides a warm bed where travelers can rest and recover beneath the mountain.

angles.text: As a dwarf returning from patrol across Khaz Modan, you can find the comforting warmth of home and a reliable mug of dwarven stout at Firebrew’s tavern.
As an Alliance traveler from abroad, you can rest at the central safe haven Firebrew keeps near Ironforge’s front gates, in King Magni Bronzebeard’s capital. Firebrew is the primary innkeeper there.
